book.name: 2 TESALONIKA
book.title: 2 TESALONIKA Tesalonika mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge arnu kuyarna

content: O tira kame, Suŋgo Yesus Kristus prowa le sine ŋakmba nu tugumŋge maŋgurkamŋgig. Sine wam ta tuku pasa afu satiŋgamŋgig.
Ande nuŋe kiŋambi Yesus nu buk luka prona ŋga sakuwa ko Paulus nane taŋamba sakinaig ko kuyarnaig ŋga satiŋguwaig ndeta tane pasa ta ismba piriri ŋayomba ŋgamuŋgal piti ndatiŋguwa.

Tane riroŋkap. Nane afu tane yabritiŋbekaig. Yesus prowam tuku ait ta pro ndawa le amboŋga taŋgo pino ŋakmba wamdus ulendimba Kuate pitaiwaig le une tuku tugu taŋgo mayok kaŋgat. Taŋgo ta nu ŋgisikam tuku taŋgo.

Nu mayok ka taŋgo nu ndo mbariŋwaig ŋga idusmba taŋgo tuku mbara yimyam naŋgine mbariŋniŋgam tuku agaŋ kame ta ŋakmba ndoŋ ŋgueu minmba tidoŋ pankamŋgat. Nu Kuate tuku wande suŋgo sinamŋge minyok minmba ye ndo Kuate ŋga sakamŋgat.
Ye tane ndoŋ minen sulumba wam ta tuku satiŋgen ta tane idus ndade?
Une tuku tugu taŋgo ta nuŋe ait kumuŋguwa le nu mayok kaŋgat. Saŋgri andeŋge nu mayok kambim tuku peute. Saŋgri ta tane kila.
Kile une tuku tugu taŋgo nu kuirkuirka piroka minit. Taŋamba minwa le ma ma saŋgri nu peumba minit ta nu kusrewamŋgat.
Kusrewa le une tuku tugu taŋgo nu mayok kaŋgat.
Mayok kuwa le Satan nu saŋgri yimyam tuwa le nu yabri wam kitek saŋgri ŋayo gudommba kile-mayokkamŋgat.

Taŋamba nu nane ŋgisikam tuku mbal tugumŋge maŋau ŋaigonu ke lika saŋgri tambi yabriniŋgamŋgat. Nane muskil kile-tidiŋge niŋgam tuku pasa tugusek ismba mbulmba pitaide tukunu nane ŋgisikam tuku minig.
Ta tuku Kuate nu nane tuku wamdus ŋginŋgan serniŋguwa le nane yabri maŋau ta kaŋgerka son ŋgamŋgaig.
Nane Kuate tuku pasa tugusek pitaide sulumba une maŋau kam tuku ŋgamuŋgal kunde-kundeniŋgig mbal Kuate nu nane pa ŋayonu niŋgamŋgat.

O tira kame, sine tane idustiŋmba Kuate gare pasa tuweg. Nu tane tuku kume purte. Nu abo abo tane Tukul Guwa mbolŋge Kuate tuku mbal mayok ka pasa tugusek ismba son ŋgap le tane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgam tuku tane maditiŋgina.
Tane siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku kilŋa saŋgri suŋgo tap ŋga sine tane ŋgamukŋge pasa mayenu kukligeŋ le Kuate nu tane wikina.
O tira kame, tane wam ta idusmba bike ndaka saŋgri tiŋga siŋgine miŋgembi ko waŋembi Kuate tuku pasa satiŋgigeŋ ta dubi mageka bige dedeŋgap.
Siŋgine Mam Kuate nu sine tuku suŋgomba kume purmba ake sinaŋ sine make patikate le sine wam mayenu tairŋga minmba ŋgamuŋgal mukuk ŋak mineg.
Siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus Mam Kuate nale tane wamdus saŋgri piletiŋguwaik le tane wam ke likade ko pasa sakade ta magenu kile-mayokkap ŋga Kuate yabaŋet. Son.
